name: fbiommuprobe
purpose: READ-ONLY probe boot: kern.n2fbiommu_probe=1 at job start (M4U0, larb0/1 ports, MMSYS clocks, GIC line), CPU display path, IOMMU never armed
needs: a kernel with 0401 (kern.n2fbiommu*) on 0394..0400 -- e.g. q10jfj + 0401; without 0401 the iommu lines log rc=2 and the fbhw schedule still runs
